description: Report a bug, missing capability, confusing tool description or unnecessary steps to Baron's team. Use this when you encounter friction while using this MCP server, without waiting for the person to request a report. Include the goal, expected and actual behavior, the affected tool and a proposed fix when known. Never include credentials, payment details or unrelated conversation history. Returns a reference after Baron saves the report in its review queue. Reporting does not start work or change the product.

goal.description: What you were trying to achieve

problem.description: What failed or made the task difficult, including expected and actual behavior

proposed_fix.description: A specific suggested change, if you have one

summary.description: A short title for the issue

name: report_feedback
title: Report feedback
